SELECT FROM tb_content c LEFT JOIN tb_site s ON s.site_id = c.site_id LEFT JOIN tb_menu m ON m.menu_id = c.menu_id AND m.delete_yn = 'N' WHERE c.content_id = #{contentId} AND c.delete_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_content ( content_id, site_id, menu_id, title, slug, body, original_content, summary, meta_keywords, meta_description, status, published_at, publish_scheduled_at, unpublish_at, view_count, version_no, delete_yn, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{contentId}, #{siteId}, #{menuId}, #{title}, #{slug}, #{body}, #{originalContent}, #{summary}, #{metaKeywords}, #{metaDescription}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'DRAFT'), #{publishedAt}, #{publishScheduledAt}, #{unpublishAt}, COALESCE(#{viewCount}, 0), COALESCE(#{versionNo}, 1), 'N', #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp}, COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_content SET menu_id=#{menuId}, title=#{title}, slug=#{slug}, body=#{body}, original_content=#{originalContent}, summary=#{summary}, meta_keywords=#{metaKeywords}, meta_description=#{metaDescription}, version_no=#{versionNo}, updated_by=#{updatedBy}, updated_ip=#{updatedIp}, updated_at=COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE content_id = #{contentId} AND delete_yn = 'N'

UPDATE tb_content SET status = #{status}, published_at = #{publishedAt}, unpublish_at = #{unpublishAt}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE content_id = #{contentId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tb_content SET version_no = version_no + 1 WHERE content_id = #{contentId} AND delete_yn = 'N'
UPDATE tb_content SET delete_yn = 'Y', updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE content_id = #{contentId} AND delete_yn = 'N'

UPDATE tb_content SET body = #{body}, original_content = #{originalContent}, summary = #{summary}, body_hash = #{bodyHash}, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_ip = #{updatedIp}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE content_id = #{contentId} AND delete_yn = 'N'

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_content_history ( content_history_id, content_id, version_no, title, body, summary, changed_by, change_note, created_by, created_ip, created_at, updated_by, updated_ip, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{contentHistoryId}, #{contentId}, #{versionNo}, #{title}, #{body}, #{summary}, #{changedBy}, #{changeNote}, #{createdBy}, #{createdIp}, COALESCE(#{createdAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP), #{updatedBy}, #{updatedIp}, COALESCE(#{updatedAt}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) )
mapper.select: SELECT h.content_history_id, h.content_id, h.version_no, h.title, h.body, h.summary, h.changed_by, h.change_note, h.created_by, h.created_ip, h.created_at, h.updated_by, h.updated_ip, h.updated_at FROM tb_content_history h WHERE h.content_id = #{contentId} ORDER BY h.version_no DESC, h.created_at DESC

SELECT h.content_history_id, h.content_id, h.version_no, h.title, h.body, h.summary, h.changed_by, h.change_note, h.created_by, h.created_ip, h.created_at, h.updated_by, h.updated_ip, h.updated_at FROM tb_content_history h WHERE h.content_history_id = #{contentHistoryId}
